# naming.grammar.c84-parser-context-extents

Kind: `native-observation`

## Problem statement

Compilation and runtime diagnostics can select different portions of the same malformed source. Empty context is a valid extent and must not be treated as missing geometry.

## Question

What command start, remaining size, parser term and result/errorInfo extent does Tcl 8.4 retain for the 27 original source inputs?

## Conclusion

The counted-source probe records 26 parser failures and one accepted command that fails at runtime. Compilation excludes a final parser term where recorded; runtime includes its term. The raw-NUL source transport precedes diagnostic rendering. No traces, return-options or cache ownership are measured.
